name: Kurumi Meushi
source: Kurumi should have been a cow but after a strange deformity, she came into the world with strange ear-hair, which earned her regular mockery from humans and "real" cows. The difficult life she leads taught her to be strong and even if she hides her weaknesses by excessively protecting her cousin, who is also her only real friend, she is not much more confident.
